Q: sum multiple columns with sumif function in excel A:

What about this formula. This sums all cells in all columns which row's A cell equal to condition in cell I1. Result in J1.

This formula is in column H

=IF(A1=$I$1,SUM(INDIRECT("C"&ROW()&":G"&ROW())),0)

Result formula in J1.

=SUM(H2:H100)

OR

=SUM(B1:G100*($I$1=A1:A100))

where in I1 cell is the value to search to sum. And instead B1:G100 sequence from B1:B100

Q: ERROR: Checkmarx Scan Failed: No files to scan in Jenkins while CxSAST Scan A:

I am experiencing the same problem using Bamboo, "No files to zip."

The solution is by creating a new "Source Code Checkout (Checkout from repository)" task before the CxSAST Scanning task, on the same Job.

Q: Excel 2010 comparing multiple columns (2 columns to 2 other columns) A:

A simple variant would be to use the function CONCATENATE() to concatenate a search string from the two columns. Afterwards you can compare the columns with various functions VLOOKUP(), MATCH().....

Q: coordinate proximity for likert scale analysis (php) A:

(x,y) is indeed a position.

I concur, on a graph, but it can also be a tuple.

It is impossible to represent two different metrics on a single axis.

I can represent distance and magnitude in one dimension, on a single axis:

E.g., (distance 5 units, magnitude positive 4)

ticks/points (optional): 0123456789ABCDEF
           single axis : ----++++++------

This is neither points 4, 5, nor 9 (helps to think of how this helps a lot at higher dimensions)
